_comment: Ready-to-merge Managed Agent config: connect these MCP servers to your agent (agent_01...). 'mcp_servers' declares each server (type/name/url, NO auth); each 'mcp_toolset' entry exposes that server's tools. Auth for each is a Vault credential keyed to the SAME url (static_bearer or mcp_oauth) -- create it with add_vault_credential.py, then attach the vault via the client's VAULT_IDS at session create. See README.md. Keep only the servers you want; delete the rest. These are the same presets as deploy/claude-code/add-mcp.sh, so the two planes stay in sync.
